Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants learning basic vehicle control before practice driving and the road test.
Why it matters to a first-timer: signal rules and hand signals are classic knowledge-test items [A04], and the reversing and turning rules preview what the road test asks for [A05].
Level: rule and procedure recall with some exact figures (signal distance, horn range, reverse speed, curb distance, stopping table rows); moderate load.
Prerequisites: the starting checklist and mirror setup from the previous section.
